description: An adjustable bench fixture for cutting the projecting edges of several gathered sections to a uniform width before sewing. A guide board or straight edge is set to the desired leaf size and the surplus paper is sliced away against it, with a backing board protecting the bed from the blade.
name: trimming machine

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1901), Chapter VI, p.93. Internet Archive.
